# Phlix

> Phlix (App Store name "Phlix Photos") is an independent iPhone and iPad app that works with Plex Media Server. It shows the photos and videos in your Plex photo libraries by folder or on a date timeline with a year scrubber, saves them to the Photos app or straight into an album, and plays slideshows; with Screen Mirroring on, or over an HDMI adapter, the TV shows just the photos while your iPhone shows the controls. From version 1.0.21, Camera Upload (Beta) backs up the photos and videos on an iPhone or iPad to the user's own Plex photo library, on the home Wi-Fi only. Phlix is not made by Plex.

Phlix is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Plex, Inc.
Plex, the Plex Play logo, and Plex Media Server are trademarks of Plex GmbH and used under a license.

A longer version of this file, with every feature, the Camera Upload setup and the FAQ: https://phlixapp.com/llms-full.txt

## Answers

### What happened to Plex Camera Upload?
Plex announced on its forum on March 18, 2021 that it was ending support for Camera Upload in its apps, with removal targeted for June 2021; photos already uploaded stayed in Plex. Source: Plex's announcement "Important info about Camera Upload in Plex" (archived copy, the original page is no longer online): https://web.archive.org/web/20210319005631/https://forums.plex.tv/t/important-info-about-camera-upload-in-plex/700626 . In August 2025 a moderator on Plex's forum wrote that the feature "was discontinued about 4 years ago": https://forums.plex.tv/t/plex-photos-app-not-uploading-to-server/927683 . Full answer: https://phlixapp.com/plex-camera-upload/

### How do I back up iPhone photos to Plex?
Plex shows the photos that are in a folder of a Plex photo library, after it scans. So phone photos must be copied into such a folder. To do that automatically, use Camera Upload (Beta) in Phlix: install the free Phlix Camera Upload helper (one Docker container) on the machine that runs Plex Media Server, pointed at a folder inside the Plex photo library, then turn on Settings > Camera Upload in Phlix. It uploads only on the home Wi-Fi, never over mobile data, to the user's own server only, as a one-way copy that never deletes anything on the phone. The first 100 uploads are free; Phlix Pro uploads the rest. It needs Phlix 1.0.21 or later. If the App Store does not offer that version yet, it is on its way. Setup guide: https://phlixapp.com/camera-upload/ . By hand, without an app: copy the photos into that folder (for example from the iPhone's Files app connected to a shared folder on the server, or from a computer), then let Plex scan.

### Is there an alternative to the Plex Photos app?
Plex Photos is Plex's own free app for photo libraries; its App Store page lists Recommended View, Timeline View and Library View, and its latest version is 2025.2.0 (June 12, 2025). Phlix is an independent alternative for iPhone and iPad that works with the same Plex Media Server: folders and a date timeline with a year scrubber, slideshows that include subfolders, saves to Photos or an album, big-screen slideshows on the TV, and Camera Upload (Beta). It is free to browse. Full answer: https://phlixapp.com/plex-photos-alternative/

## Facts

- Website: https://phlixapp.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/phlix-photos/id6796820208 (App ID 6796820208)
- Developer: Jason Loomis (independent developer)
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS and iPadOS 17 or later. A Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 14 or later) can install the iPad version; Apple lists it as designed for iPad, not verified for macOS.
- Category: Photo & Video
- Current App Store version: 1.0.20. Camera Upload (Beta) comes with version 1.0.21. If the App Store does not offer that version yet, it is on its way.
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian Bokmål, Finnish, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
- Needs: a Plex Media Server with at least one photo library, and a Plex account. No Plex Pass on the home network. Away from home, Plex may require the server owner to have a Plex Pass (or the user a Remote Watch Pass) before it serves files remotely to any app, including Phlix.

## Features

- Folders that follow the folders on the server, and a date timeline one tap away, with a year scrubber: tap 1987 to see just that year
- Built for big libraries: loads a page at a time instead of everything at once (libraries of 100,000+ photos)
- Full-screen viewer with pinch to zoom, and a video player that remembers where you stopped
- Slideshows of a folder, a year or the whole library; a folder's slideshow also plays the folders inside it (switch: Include Subfolders); 2, 4, 6 or 10 seconds a slide, shuffle, loop, hard cuts between photos
- Big-screen slideshows (Pro): with Screen Mirroring on, or over an HDMI adapter, the TV shows just the photos while your iPhone shows the controls. Without Pro, the TV mirrors the phone.
- Save to Photos: 25 free saves, unlimited with Pro. The original file when the server sends it; otherwise a copy the server converted, which may be smaller.
- Save to Album: pick an album once (Settings > Storage > Save to Album, or ••• on a photo > Save to Album…) and every save goes into it
- Camera Upload (Beta, from version 1.0.21): backs up the device's photos and videos to a folder of the user's Plex photo library through a free helper next to Plex Media Server; home Wi-Fi only; encrypted (HTTPS, pinned certificate); the Plex server's owner pairs without a code, others with the helper's pairing code; first 100 uploads free
- Search photo and video titles, tags and collections; favorites saved on the device
- Your own server or one shared with you; switch between its photo libraries
- On cellular and in Low Data Mode, Phlix stops loading ahead
- iPad sidebar with your libraries; VoiceOver support
- Sign-in on Plex's own sign-in page: Phlix never sees the password, and there is no Phlix account
- Phlix never changes or deletes what is on the server; Camera Upload only adds new files, in the folder chosen for it

## Pricing

- Free: browsing, timeline, year scrubber, search, favorites, on-device slideshows, 25 saves to Photos, and the first 100 camera uploads (Beta, from version 1.0.21)
- Pro Lifetime: $19.99 once, with Family Sharing. Unlimited saves, big-screen slideshows, unlimited camera uploads (Beta)
- Pro Yearly: $6.99 a year, renews until cancelled. Same Pro features
- 14-day trial of Pro: not a subscription, never renews, never charges

## Privacy

- No ads, no tracking pixels, no session replay, no third-party advertising SDKs
- Anonymous usage, error and crash statistics tied to a random ID on the device, never the user's name, Plex account, photos, file names or server address; can be turned off in Settings
- Camera Upload sends photos only to the helper on the user's own server, never to the developer
- Privacy policy: https://phlixapp.com/privacy/

## Camera Upload helper

- Source code (public): https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload
- README: https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload/blob/main/README.md
- Releases: https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload/releases
- Issues: https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload/issues
- Docker image: ghcr.io/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload (tags 1, 1.0, 1.0.1, latest; amd64, arm64, armv7): https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload/pkgs/container/phlix-camera-upload
- Unraid template: https://github.com/jrl8085/phlix-camera-upload/blob/main/unraid/phlix-camera-upload.xml
- One-command install (Linux, Mac with Docker Desktop): curl -fsSL https://phlixapp.com/camera-upload/install.sh | sh
- Compose file: https://phlixapp.com/camera-upload/docker-compose.yml
- Instructions for an AI assistant: https://phlixapp.com/camera-upload/SETUP-WITH-AI.md
